title: Split the utils grab-bag into focused modules
prompt: `src/utils.js` mixes string, array and object helpers. Split it into `src/string.js` (string helpers only), `src/array.js` (array helpers only) and `src/object.js` (object helpers only) with identical function behaviour. `src/utils.js` must stay as a thin module that re-exports every function (the very same function objects), so existing imports keep working, and `src/report.js` must import from the focused modules instead of `./utils.js`. Do not export extra names from the new modules beyond the helpers that belong to them. Run the tests with `npm test`.
